timeDomains.name: 1. Yo‘l poyini saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
2. Asfaltbeton qoplamalarni saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
3. Tsementbeton qoplamalarni saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
4. Qora-shag‘al qoplamalarni saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
5. Shag‘alli va chaqilgan toshli qoplamalarni saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
6. Tuproq yo‘lni saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari (6 m kenglikda)
7. Sun’iy inshootlarni saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
8. Yo‘naltiruvchi ustunchalar va ajratuvchi va himoyalovchi to‘siqlarni saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
9. Bir avtomobil to‘xtash maydonchasini saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
10. Bir maydonchani (dam olish) va avtomobillarning to‘xtab turish joyini saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
11. Bir dona avtobekatni saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
12. Bir dona yo‘l belgisini saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
13. Piyodalar uchun yo‘laklarni, er osti va er usti piyodalar o‘tish joylarini saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
14. Asfaltbeton bilan mustahkamlangan yo‘l chetini saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
15. Qattiq qoplamali tutashuvchi yo‘llarni saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
16. Qordan himoyalovchi to‘siqlarni saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
17. Yoritish tarmog‘ini saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
18. Ma’muriy binolar va ishlab chiqarish inshootlarini saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
19. Ko‘kalamzorlashtirish, manzarali daraxtlar va gulxonalarni saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
20. Avtomobil yo‘llarining qishki qarovi uchun vaqt me’yorlari
21. Saqlash ishlariga oid texnik ishlar uchun vaqt me’yorlari
22. Saqlash ishlarida yuklash va tushirish ishlari vaqt me’yorlari
23. Suv quduqlarini saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
24. Kanalizatsiya suv quvurlarini saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
25. Markaziy isitish quvurlarini saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
26. Suv ta’minoti quvurlarini saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
27. Tonel inshootini saqlash uchun vaqt me’yorlari
28. Avtomobil yo‘llari texnik holatini diagnostikadan o‘tkazish va baholash ishlarining 1 km avtomobil yo‘li uchun vaqt me’yorlari.
29. Avtomobil yo‘llarini yo‘l harakatini tashkil etilganligi yuzasidan auditdan o‘tkazish ishlarining 1 km avtomobil yo‘li uchun vaqt me’yorlari.

checks.rule: Each selected road has a decision for all 29 TIME topics: linked applicable work rows or reasoned not applicable. RESOURCE variants also register under appropriate physical domain. A topic having one linked row does not prove all applicable tasks considered.
Each Annex1 maintenance requirement/branch is included through matching quantity/method or explicitly not applicable with reason; inventory completeness must be attested. Check raw source conflicts.
No unresolved labor/unit/recurrence/resource quantity/rate or payroll/equipment gap may be silently counted zero for approval.
23 range rows are valid bounded choices; require selected in-range value and documented source/basis. 97 normIssue rows are unresolved, distinct from selectable ranges.
RESOURCE001-02,002-02,026-02 are incremental norms requiring an explicit base row and magnitude; never independently execute as standalone work.
For diagnostics TIME28 choose overall row43/45 OR detailed component package. For safety audit TIME29 choose overall row20/22 OR details; never both.

TIME27 whole-season operation rows16/27/43/54/62/64 already encode staffing/service packages; do not blindly sum all detailed maintenance or transfer source-specific equipment counts117, fixed2036hours, staffing to unrelated tunnels.
Alternative technology variants for same physical task are mutually exclusive unless asset scope split explicitly; automatic defaults must not duplicate manual replacement lines.
Annual snow/ice cycles derived from climate/weather/operating plan with approved basis. No universal count supplied by Annex1.
IQN02 Annex1 note calls for analysis of prior performed works and adding additional recurring types; permit additional justified work beyond preset Annex1 list.

IQN02 1.14 annual calendar with daily/monthly execution and seasonal inspections supports annual→monthly link. User requirement enforces monthly allocated+executed quantity <= approved annual quantity per road/work/unit, never sum heterogeneous physical units.

Financial/normative-labor weights from frozen approved annual rows provide comparable total progress; count only accepted executed volume and cap row execution at annual amount. Monthly plan issuance alone is not completion.
